acceptedInterpretation: Remove guessed dollar amount as a pre-run launch condition. Keep provider execution controlled by frozen Cell 03 scope, rows, retry/time/token/output limits, prompt/tool digests, dated model snapshots, owner and duplicate policy; record actual provider-reported usage/cost only after execution.
notes: This resolves the apparent conflict between safety controls and the user rejection of arbitrary budget caps: control execution by bounded task envelope, not by an invented spend amount.
